content:
令 \(Z_i=\frac{X_i}{2}\sim N(0,1)\)，则

\[
U=\sum_{i=1}^4 Z_i^2\sim \chi^2(4),\qquad V=Z_5^2\sim \chi^2(1)
\]

原不等式化为

\[
\sum_{i=1}^4 X_i^2 \le kX_5^2
\iff 4U\le 4kV
\iff U\le kV
\]

于是

\[
F=\frac{U/4}{V/1}=\frac{U}{4V}\sim F(4,1)
\]

并且

\[
U\le kV \iff \frac{U}{4V}\le \frac{k}{4}
\]

所以

\[
P\left(F\le \frac{k}{4}\right)=\alpha
\]

按国内常用记号，\(F_\alpha(4,1)\) 表示上 \(\alpha\) 分位点，即

\[
P(F>F_\alpha(4,1))=\alpha
\]

因此

\[
P\left(F\le \frac{k}{4}\right)=\alpha
\iff
P\left(F>\frac{k}{4}\right)=1-\alpha
\]

从而

\[
\frac{k}{4}=F_{1-\alpha}(4,1)
\]

所以

\[
k=4F_{1-\alpha}(4,1)
\]

答案：D
